styleLock.direction: slate-blue whole-room custom soft-furnishing commerce, mid-tone graphic interior with charcoal copy bands rather than airy daylight or dark editorial
styleLock.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real living room with a mid-tone slate blue-grey wall #75808D over a pale marble-look floor #D8D5CF, a seamless paper off-white studio field #F1F1EE or pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, and full-width near-black charcoal copy bands #1C1F24 with one offset charcoal rectangle framing a photograph as the recurring graphic device; right-angle corners throughout, no rounded cards, one clean copy zone per screen and never busy decor
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral indoor mixed light at 4000-4300K: a soft window source off camera left plus two shallow elliptical ceiling downlight pools washing the slate wall above the seating, one grounded contact shadow under the sofa only, wide gentle falloff, controlled soft speculars and no hotspots; this is deliberately NOT a cool 6500K north-daylight wash and NOT a dark low-key raking editorial grade; every piece sits on a visible contact shadow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte woven upholstery rendered exactly as supplied in pale blue-grey #C6CCD1, pale marble-look floor #D8D5CF with a soft sheen, matte low-pile geometric triangle rug in lilac-blue #A8AECB, grey #B9BCC4, mustard #E4C96A and white #F2F2EF, matte black metal #23262A open shelving, matte paper and charcoal graphic fields; never gloss lacquer, never vinyl or leather sheen
styleLock.typography: one heavy bold geometric sans-serif family for Chinese headlines set in #F1F1EE on charcoal bands and in #1C1F24 on light fields, plus the same family at light weight for labels, numerals and dimension words; small letter-spaced uppercase English kicker lines only, two weights of one family, never a serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon face; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-32pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-12pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters
styleLock.iconSystem: 2px circular-framed monoline pictograms with one small solid glyph inside, drawn in #1C1F24 on light fields and #F1F1EE on slate fields, plus oversized bold bare numerals 01-06 in #1C1F24 with no chips and no containers, maximum six per screen, 1px hairline rules for tables; no filled illustration, no 3D badges, no gradient seals, no pill labels
styleLock.presentationRules: the sectional keeps one proportional scale, the same low flat arm profile, the same seat and back cushion count, the same chaise side, the same topstitched seam pattern and the same slim tapered black metal leg form in every frame; it stands on the floor with a real contact shadow and never floats; interior verticals, wall corners, picture frames and floor lines stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (rug, round coffee table, open shelf, plant on a stand) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 seated angle of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
noDrift: no recoloured, re-woven or re-tufted upholstery, no vinyl or leather look
no added or removed chaise module, no invented headrest, quilting, piping or buttons
no inconsistent lighting direction, no missing downlight pools and no contradictory shadow lengths
no mismatched icon or numeral styles
no drift toward a cool 6500K nordic daylight grade or a dark brass editorial grade
no invented dimensions, fabric or foam densities, board grades, eco ratings, hardware brands, warranty years, price per square metre or certificates
no brand mark, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no contact details
no people, no hands and no visible faces; any reused figure must be anonymous and cropped

provenance.notes: 7 张详情页切片压缩为 11 镜，漏斗排序：灰蓝墙客厅成套首屏 → 白底转角主图 → 空墙角与占位痛点俯视分屏 → 贵妃位生活场景 → 坐垫明线织纹微距 → 转角连接位贴地仰视 → 直排位与转角贵妃位占位对比 → 定制流程六步 → 三种风格案例三联 → 四项保障与通用规格表 → 收口动作。品类判定：本夹（全屋家装定制 3）反复实拍的唯一主体是出现在第 1、3、4、5、6 屏的浅灰蓝布艺 L 型转角沙发与它的客厅成套软装（板岩灰蓝墙、几何三角地毯、黑色开放层架、鹿头挂画、圆几），第 4 屏上方的新中式实木茶桌椅组只是 定制案例展示 里的一种风格案例插图、与 北欧时尚风／欧式典雅风 并列，并非主体，全篇没有衣柜、橱柜、榻榻米或任何柜体与板材结构，故按图片主体取 L1 家具家纺、L2 客厅家具、leaf 浅灰蓝布艺L型转角沙发，不取 家装灯具/建材 也不套用 收纳家具。已剥离：源图全部中文营销字（全屋定制 适合你空间／个性设计 舒适浪漫／风格统一／省时省力／售后保障／功能性强／定制案例展示／北欧时尚风／复古新中式／欧式典雅风／hello生活 让理想家更舒适／一站式服务／售后有保障／全屋定制流程／咨询客服／交付定金／测量尺寸／沟通方案／等待生产／上门安装／产品信息／个性设计 简约而不简单 独具时尚气质）与英文填充字 HOME FASHION、Individual design comfortable and romantic、CHARACTER DESIGNS、Let the ideal home more comfortable，全部改写为 {selling_point_*}／{callout_*} 占位；末页『加入会员 全店免费』角标与二维码、店铺与公司自称、一站式与售后保障承诺一律不作为事实入图。产品信息表的 型号／风格／适用空间／颜色／环保等级／房屋类型 保留为通用行名，数值一律置为占位符，未生成任何环保等级、板材级别与厚度、五金品牌、质保年限、每平米报价、填充密度或认证。源图无人物出镜，本套同样禁止人物与手部，若后续复用出现设计师也必须是匿名且被裁切的局部。所有垂直线（墙角、画框、地毯边、层架立柱）按校正竖直处理，并以圆几、地毯、层架与绿植作为真实家具尺度锚；贵妃位朝向、坐垫与靠包数量、扶手 profile、明线缝法、织物纹路与细金属脚在全部 11 镜中锁死一致。与库内已有套图差异化：家具家纺 内十一套均为书柜／酒柜／衣柜／软包床／电视柜／花瓶摆件或另一款 北欧浅灰织物直排沙发，本模版 leaf 为带贵妃榻的转角组合沙发且核心卖点是转角占位与三种风格案例；视觉上刻意与 家具家纺/jiajujiafang-beiou-buyi-shafa 的冷调 6500K 北向柔光、米白 #F4F2ED 加雾灰蓝 #6E8494 轻盈客厅、细字无衬线与方形编号芯片、圆角卡片完全不同——本模版锁定中调板岩灰蓝墙 #75808D、通栏炭黑 #1C1F24 色带与偏移炭框包图、4000-4300K 中性室内光加两束顶射筒灯墙晕、粗黑无衬线标题加英文大写字距 kicker、圆形细线图标加裸排超大编号、直角无圆角版面；也与 家装灯具/jiazhuangdengju-mianqi-mushimianban 的低照度炭场 #1B1A18 加暖金 #B98A4E 衬线建筑感与掠射侧光体系无关，本套无衬线、无暖金、无暗场掠射。
